name: Parental Love
source:
In Parental love, you take on the role of a father of two who had a falling out with his wife, Emily. 

Due to your cocaine addiction, a while after your second daughter, Ada, was born, Emily thought it best you not be around your kids.

You two went through a break-up and the court ruled her sole custody of your children.

It's been fifteen years since then, and you've gone to multiple different rehab programs. Now that you are clean of drugs, You decided to start dating Emily once again. The relationship was online for many months because you live in different states, but now you've decided to visit Emily in Ohio. The game begins when you first meet her in a bar.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Luxee]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在《父母之爱》中，你将扮演一名与妻子艾米丽闹翻的两个孩子的父亲。

由于你的可卡因成瘾，第二个女儿艾达出生后不久，艾米丽认为你最好不要再和孩子们接触。

你们分手后，法院判决由她独自抚养孩子。

那之后已经过去15年，你参加了多个不同的戒毒项目。如今你已经戒除毒品，决定再次与艾米丽约会。因为你们住在不同州，这段关系通过网络维持了数月；现在，你决定前往俄亥俄州拜访艾米丽。游戏从你们第一次在酒吧见面时开始。
